deals.travelWindow: Sep 30 – Nov 14, cheapest is the Nov 14 departure
deals.whyRanked: $62 one-way legs on Allegiant for Nov 14 (about $124 RT) — up from the $93 low earlier this week but still the cheapest fare of the five, with the Smokies' Greenbrier entrance 45 minutes away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to explore solo on foot, and the park's Greenbrier and Cosby entrances offer quiet trails away from the Cades Cove crowds.

highlights: Market Square farmers market and street performers
Sunsphere observation deck over World's Fair Park
Ijams Nature Center quarry swimming hole
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Greenbrier entrance
itinerary: Day 1 — Market Square and the Sunsphere, dinner in the Old City.
Day 2 — Ijams Nature Center trails in the morning, Mabry-Hazen House and downtown murals in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Greenbrier: the Ramsey Cascades or Porters Creek trailhead before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and Ijams are walkable or a short rideshare apart; a rental car is required to reach the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square or Gay Street — walkable, close to restaurants and the Tennessee Theatre.

deals.whyRanked: $131 RT nonstop on American for Saturday departures through December — holding steady at the same low fare for a second straight day.
deals.soloWhy: Uptown and Deep Ellum are walkable, transit-friendly pockets, though the city overall is spread out enough that a car or rideshare budget helps.

highlights: The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza
Deep Ellum street art and live music
Perot Museum of Nature and Science
itinerary: Day 1 — The Sixth Floor Museum and Dealey Plaza, walk the Katy Trail into Uptown for dinner.
Day 2 — Perot Museum in the morning, Deep Ellum mural walk and live music at night.
Day 3 — Bishop Arts District boutiques and coffee, Klyde Warren Park before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The DART light rail connects Downtown, Uptown, and Deep Ellum; a rideshare is worth it for Bishop Arts.
guide.stayArea: Uptown along the Katy Trail — walkable, quiet at night, a short DART ride from Deep Ellum.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 6 – Oct 10 flash sale, wider Oct-Nov nonstop availability
deals.whyRanked: $149 RT nonstop on Delta for the Oct 6–10 flash sale window, with Everglades and Biscayne National Parks both under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: South Beach's Art Deco streets stay busy and walkable well into the night, though a rental car is what really opens up the two national parks.

highlights: South Beach Art Deco Historic District
Biscayne NP's Dante Fascell Visitor Center
itinerary: Day 1 — South Beach Art Deco walking tour, Lincoln Road, sunset swim.
Day 2 — Everglades NP: Anhinga Trail boardwalk and the Shark Valley bike loop.
Day 3 — Vizcaya Museum & Gardens in the morning, Wynwood Walls before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: A rental car is worth it for the Everglades and Biscayne day trips; South Beach itself is walkable, with the free Freebee shuttle covering Miami Beach.
guide.stayArea: South Beach's Art Deco district — walkable, close to the sand and Lincoln Road.
food: Garcia's Seafood Grille on the Miami River

deals.travelWindow: Oct 27 – Nov 3 confirmed low, wider Sep-Nov nonstop availability
deals.whyRanked: $179 RT nonstop on Delta for the Oct 27 – Nov 3 window, with Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor still just 90 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: A compact, walkable downtown with a free shuttle, plus an easy mountain day trip that needs no technical hiking skill.

itinerary: Day 1 — Union Station, 16th Street Mall, RiNo Art District mural walk.
Day 2 — Day trip to Rocky Mountain NP for the Bear Lake corridor (in-park shuttle handles the parking).
Day 3 — Denver Botanic Gardens in the morning, Larimer Square for dinner.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with a free 16th Street shuttle; a rental car is worth it for the Rocky Mountain NP day trip.
guide.stayArea: LoDo (Lower Downtown) — near Union Station and walkable to RiNo.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 5 flash sale, wider Sep-Nov nonstop availability
deals.whyRanked: $249 RT nonstop on Delta's flash sale, with Cabrillo National Monument and Torrey Pines each a short trolley-and-drive from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Balboa Park, the Gaslamp Quarter, and the coastal trolley make this one of the most solo-friendly warm-weather cities in the country.

itinerary: Day 1 — Balboa Park museums and Botanical Garden, Gaslamp Quarter for dinner.
Day 2 — Cabrillo National Monument tide pools and the Old Point Loma Lighthouse, sunset at Sunset Cliffs.
Day 3 — Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve hike, La Jolla Cove seals, trolley back downtown.
guide.gettingAround: The MTS trolley and buses cover downtown, Old Town, and the beaches; a car isn't required but helps reach Torrey Pines faster.
guide.stayArea: Gaslamp Quarter or Little Italy — walkable, trolley-accessible, close to the bay.
